prompts.Erde: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide literary fantasy guide illustration, matching a naturalist travel sketch in detailed ink and restrained watercolor on warm paper. Primary request: the river country of Erde, where settlements, river gardens and boats connect communities across a broad basin. Scene: a high riverbank overlooking a wide branching river, fields and gardens on raised ground, modest stone and timber settlements with landing stages, small practical sailing boats, wooded hills and distant mountain chains. A river defense embankment and a shaded assembly courtyard belong naturally to the settlement. Composition: 3:2 landscape, no border, no lettering. Colors muted river blue, foliage green, earth ochre; diffuse daylight. Constraints: no people in close-up, no castles or spectacular magical effects, no invented named landmarks, no modern machinery; no map labels or text. This is a plausible illustrative scene based on a fictional public guide, not a map of a fixed place.
prompts.Dverghamar: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide landscape illustration for a literary fantasy world's public guide. Primary request: Dverghamar's inhabited twilight landscape, based on these established facts: permanent low sunward light, mountains divide fertile watered districts from dry basins, houses built inside rock, surface farms, roads and river works, water wheels driving workshops. Scene: view across a river valley with cultivated terraces in the foreground and homes cut into a rocky mountain flank, a modest water wheel beside a stream, distant dry ridges fading toward amber haze; cool shadowed mountains on the other side. Style: detailed ink and restrained watercolor on warm paper, naturalist travel sketch with convincing terrain and masonry, quiet lived-in atmosphere, earthy green, ochre and slate. Composition: 3:2 landscape, image fills frame, no border, no text. Constraints: no people, no creatures, no invented species, no fantastic glowing crystals, no grandiose impossible citadels, no lava or underground farms; the low sun need not be in frame. This is an illustrative local scene, not a geographic map. Save the final image for use in the project.
prompts.Merenval: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape illustration for the Merenval chapter of a literary fantasy guide. Primary request: Merenval's strongly maritime landscape, connected seas, forests, wetlands, islands and river settlements. Scene: view from a wooded river mouth through green islands and tidal inlets toward the open sea, modest boats and well-used wooden landing stages, homes among trees above the water, pale inhabited companion world prominent but not enormous in the sky, its face softly indistinct. Style: finely observed ink and restrained watercolor on warm paper, naturalist travel book, sea green, muted blue, warm wood, soft daylight; realistic terrain and practical architecture. Composition: wide 3:2, no border. Constraints: no close-up people, no invented creatures, no labels or text, no futuristic architecture or gigantic crescent filling the sky. The sky depiction is illustrative; do not imply an exact angular size or coastline.
prompts.GnomeHouse: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: inline fantasy naturalist illustration explaining Gnome living houses. Primary request: a cultivated living home of a Gnome household on Merenval's inhabited companion. Public facts: Gnomes cultivate homes from many organisms and symbiotic communities; living tissue can grow around a wood, stone, ceramic or metal framework; these houses are tended and repaired; household workshops combine sophisticated clockwork with living sensors. Scene: an unoccupied sheltered courtyard within a cavern-edge home, low human-shaped doorways woven from dense fungal fiber around stone supports, visibly fibrous cream and ochre living wall tissues, small assay gardens in ceramic trays, a workbench with delicate brass regulator and replaceable mechanical parts, watered channels, practical hand tools, warm daylight from the cavern mouth. House is integrated with rock and timber and living membranes, neither a giant toadstool nor an animal. Style: detailed ink and muted watercolor travel illustration on warm paper, believable artisan household, 3:2 landscape. Constraints: no people or humanoids, no faces in walls, no eyes, no horror or slime, no glowing magic, no text or labels, no monumental palace. This is one illustrative house, not a universal Gnome architectural style.
